text:
maria.ops: Quick heads-up — NexaLogistics flagged 3 units from PO#489211 as DOA, currently on customs hold in Antwerp. They want direction: air-divert to FRA (faster, higher cost) or consolidate at origin (delay ~3 days, lower cost). AWB/serials below, need decision by EOD so we can avoid extra port fees.

vendor_shipbot: Shipping update from vendor:
```
AWB: 210-79345216 / 210-79345217
PO: 489211
Model: H100-80GB (FW 2.3.1)
Serials: H100-ANP-00123, H100-ANP-00124, H100-ANP-00125
Current location: Antwerp port (CNTR yard)
Customs request: missing HS code + commercial invoice copy
```
Options: 1) Air-divert to FRA, express customs clearance, ETA 2024-12-01, expedite surcharge $7,200 (carrier quote), vendor offers one-time DOA credit $1,000 if DOA confirmed. 2) Consolidate both AWBs at origin into single MAWB and ship sea/air hybrid — add 3 days, consolidation fee $1,500, no expedite surcharge. Loaner option: 1x H100 loaner for up to 30 days available at $500/day. Will provide burn-in report & S/N list on approval.

andrew.logistics: Can we consolidate to avoid two brokerage fees? Who pays brokerage if customs assesses duties separately?

vendor_shipbot: Consolidation reduces chance of double brokerage, but final brokerage charged by customs office on arrival. Vendor can pre-pay brokerage and invoice us, or we can pay direct on clearance. Vendor willing to pre-pay if buyer accepts 48h hold and consolidation — they'll waive consolidation fee if we accept the 3-day delay.

devin.procurement: Quick math: air-divert net = $7,200 - $1,000 credit = $6,200. Consolidation = $1,500 fee + uncertain brokerage (estimate $800) = ~$2,300 and +3 days. Infra needs immediate capacity — @sam.infra you good with loaner?

sam.infra: Loaner helps but need compatibility checks — confirm power/firmware and rack adapters. Also require burn-in logs and S/Ns before accepting into cluster. If vendor can guarantee same firmware branch and provide 24h soak logs we can accept.

maria.ops: @sam.infra can you approve 30d loaner contingent on burn-in? If yes, consolidation seems preferable (lower cost). If not, we escalate to air-divert.

sam.infra: Approve loaner 30d contingent on: vendor supplies S/Ns, burn-in (24h mem/cpu/thermal), and remote access for health checks. No additional swap windows.

vendor_shipbot: Acknowledged — will provide S/N list and 24h burn-in reports within 12 hours. Consolidation hold until 2024-12-01 confirmed. Vendor will waive consolidation fee if buyer accepts 3-day delay and will pre-pay brokerage to speed clearance (vendor invoice to follow). Proforma for air-divert available on request.

maria.ops: OK — decision: consolidate at origin with vendor-prepaid brokerage and loaner request. @devin.procurement hold payment until we receive burn-in logs and proforma. vendor_shipbot please start customs paperwork and share HS code/classification (we need formal confirmation). :thumbsup:

vendor_shipbot: Will open customs dossier and send HS code + commercial invoice copy shortly. Estimated final ETA (post-consolidation) 2024-12-04.

maria.ops: Thanks — will follow up if port fees escalate.
